title: COSI — Performance Payload
description: Payload for Performance messages (assetClass=performance). Validated as the payload property of the message envelope.

StreamItem.description: One input or output stream. Quantities are cumulative for the identified scope and counting period, regardless of hbt/cos trigger. Compare compatible readings; do not add successive totals. Article change alone does not reset a counter. See Technical Guide § 3.5.

pieces.description: Cumulative discrete units at the defined counting point; use a consistent unit and counting basis within the period.

stacks.description: Cumulative count of physical stacks, not sheets per stack.

EnergyItem.description: Cumulative resource counters for the identified machine, stream or job and counting period. Distinguish measured totals from allocated shares; do not add shares to their source total. Reporting measured totals alone is permitted.

stacks.description: Cumulative physical stack count for the identified scope and period; not sheets per stack.

Speed.description: Current and target machine speed. The target baseline is supplied by ERP/MES according to the plant's business rules; COSI does not prescribe its calculation method.

uom.description: pcs/h for converting equipment; m/min for corrugators.

LogisticsStatusItem.description: Status of one logistics conveyor or buffer section. Quantities describe current contents at observation time, not cumulative throughput. stacks counts physical stacks.

movement.description: Optional movement status, subject to supplier/customer agreement. When provided, use the defined values; see message-properties.md.

DiePressureItem.description: Die pressure at a given time during production of the job, in kN.

speed.description: Current and target speed. Null when unavailable or not applicable. Zero is an actual reported speed, not a missing value.

energy.description: Energy and resource consumption counters. One entry per stream or job.

inputs.description: Consumed material streams (raw material infeed). Scope: roll stand to stacker for corrugators; pre-prefeeder to post-palletizer for converting.

logisticsStatus.description: Optional: status of logistics conveyor and buffer sections.

diePressure.description: Optional: die pressure reading for flat-bed die cutters having such option, in kN.
